candidate_evidence.quote: Phase 1 dose escalation - Multiple doses of LY3410738

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor, where standard curative or palliative measures are no longer effective or are not considered appropriate or safe in the opinion of the investigator.

role_evidence.quote: The maximum tolerated dose (MTD)/recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of LY3410738 alone or in combination with gemcitabine plus cisplatin or in combination with durvalumab

source_quote.quote: Evidence of IDH1 R132 mutation (any solid tumor) or circulating tumor DNA IDH2 R140 or IDH2 R172 mutation (cholangiocarcinoma only)

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket for IDH1/2-mutant tumours. Glioblastoma appears only in keywords (not conditions, title or inclusion criteria), and IDH-mutant glioma is not glioblastoma under CNS5, so coded not_glioblastoma per C7. Gemcitabine, cisplatin and durvalumab are approved partners in expansion cohorts 4 and 5 only; coded soc_backbone because LY3410738 is the sole investigational agent. Regimen is mixed (monotherapy escalation plus combination cohorts); coded combination. The 2-HG plasma pharmacodynamic outcome is not a tumour molecular biomarker and is not listed.
